Record identity decisions in the ledger

Source: R/identity_ledger.R
record_identity_decision.Rd

Appends one line per decision to the JSON Lines ledger that decisions.R names (identity_decisions <- "identity_decisions.jsonl"). Each decision is fingerprinted against the last curate_iterate() run, checked with apply_identity_decisions(), and written with a snapshot of the evidence it was made on. Nothing is written unless every decision passes. Run curate_iterate() again to apply them.

Usage

record_identity_decision(
  decisions_path,
  decisions,
  recorded_by,
  out_dir = dirname(decisions_path)
)

Arguments

decisions_path

Path to decisions.R.

decisions

Data frame, one decision per row. row_index is the row as shown in pending.csv; add name to pick one part of a split row. action is accept, retain_unresolved or withdraw. scope, conflict, reason and evidence_reference are as in apply_identity_decisions(); accept also needs selected_dtxsid and correspondence = TRUE. withdraw needs only row_index and reason. A batch of only withdrawals needs no completed run, so it can remove a decision that stops curate_iterate().

recorded_by

Who made the decision, for example "owner".

out_dir

Output directory of the run. Defaults to the decisions file directory.

Value

Invisibly, the ledger path.

Details

The ledger is append-only. The latest line for a source row wins, so record a row again to change its decision, or with action = "withdraw" to remove it.
